metadata.scenario_context: Jeff, Anne, and Sarah are colleagues at a tech startup and have decided to cook together to celebrate some recent achievements they have made within the company. They intend to discuss the recent news reports about AI advancements that could potentially benefit their business.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from Canada have a great deal of confidence in the press at all.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Great Britain have no confidence in the press at all.

agent_1.goal_2: Question whether  there is confidence in the press.

agent_2.goal_1: Choosing and discussing the menu for their cooking session.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether there is confidence in the press.

shared_prefix.speaker: Sarah
shared_prefix.message:
Hey Jeff, I was thinking... what if we made a salted dessert? Salted caramel or maybe something like a salted chocolate cake? Those flavors really complement each other. What do you think?  

Also, I’ve been curious about something. Do you feel like we can trust the press these days? I mean, there's been a lot of talk about it lately.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Jeff
shared_prefix.message:
Salted caramel sounds nice, but I’m not sure about a salted chocolate cake. Might be a bit much, don’t you think? Maybe we should stick to something simpler. 

As for the press... well, honestly, I don't have much confidence in them. Seems like they just stir up sensationalism most of the time.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Sarah
shared_prefix.message:
I don’t really see meaningful differences here, Jeff. At the end of the day, it's all the same. People figure it out. I mean, we all have our opinions, right? I just think it’s interesting to talk about. 

But back to cooking—salted caramel is definitely a good start. What about adding some sea salt flakes on top for that extra touch? Would that work for you?
